subject: Kickstart: Joint Adoption Starter Deck + Week-0 MAP Template
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@edgehealth.com>, Devon Lim <devon.lim@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickstart: Joint Adoption Starter Deck + Week-0 MAP Template

Hi Sarah / Devon —

Great to connect yesterday. Per our conversation, I’m attaching a compact starter deck and a lightweight Week-0 Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template you can use to map stakeholders, acceptance criteria, and a 30-day validation window. Goal here is to give you a runnable artifact for your internal kickoff next week.

Quick notes:
- Starter deck (slides) = a 6-slide kickoff you can share with execs and the clinical leads.
- Week-0 MAP (doc) = roles, milestones, required access (data/infra), and a suggested pilot acceptance matrix.
- SOW-draft (pdf) = placeholder commercial scope for review with procurement.

Could you confirm: 1) who should receive the exec slide version, and 2) who owns tech onboarding on your side so we can schedule the week-0 sync (30–45 min)?

Attachments: Joint-Adoption-Starter-Deck.gslides (slides), Week0-MAP-Template.gdoc (doc), SOW-draft.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0112

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference runtime for production LLMs

From: Sarah Park <sarah.park@edgehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Lim <devon.lim@edgehealth.com>, procurement@edgehealth.com
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: Joint Adoption Starter Deck + Week-0 MAP Template

Ben —

Thanks for sending — this looks like the right level of detail. Quick answers:
- Exec slides -> please include our Chief Product Officer (CPO) Elena Ramos and Head of Partnerships Marco Ruiz.
- Tech onboarding owner -> Devon (cc’d) will own access and infra coordination.

We have a preliminary internal kickoff scheduled for Mon 23rd at 10am PT; can you and Jasmine join for a 30–40 minute sync? Also, procurement wants a cleaned SOW with pricing placeholders before the kickoff — we’ll take the draft and mark comment lanes.

A couple of quick asks on the MAP template:
1) Can you add a short acceptance criteria section for "data privacy & retention" (we need to show retention periods and audit log footprint)?
2) Can you include a line for KMS/HSM considerations under security?

If you can make those tweaks I’ll circulate to the CPO + procurement.

Best,
Sarah
Director, Product Operations | EdgeHealth

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@edgehealth.com>, Devon Lim <devon.lim@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: Joint Adoption Starter Deck + Week-0 MAP Template

Sarah — thanks, noted. I’ll make the two security additions and push an updated Week-0 MAP (with a short acceptance matrix) by end of day today.

Proposed sync: Mon 23rd 10:00–10:30 PT — Jasmine will lead the product walkthrough; I’ll cover timeline and runbook. Tessa from Customer Success will join to outline the technical checkpoint cadence (weekly ops, health checks).

Small change log I’ll include:
- Added "Data retention & audit logs" row with sample retention buckets (30/90/365 days) and where audit logs will be surfaced in Redwood Console.
- KMS/HSM: short checklist + our supported integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, customer-managed keys note).
- Acceptance matrix: success criteria, metrics, owner, and go/no-go decision gate for day 30.

Links: Week-0 MAP (updated): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xExample-Week0MAP
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/EDGE-7890

I’ll upload the revised files and include a clean SOW stub for procurement review.

Thanks,
Ben

From: Devon Lim <devon.lim@edgehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sarah Park <sarah.park@edgehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@edgehealth.com, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: Joint Adoption Starter Deck + Week-0 MAP Template

Ben / Jasmine —

Confirmed for Mon 23rd at 10am PT. I’ll bring our infra checklist and provide access to a staging dataset for the pilot validation. Procurement flagged one commercial clarification: we need the SOW to call out data residency (US-only) and a short note on incident response SLA. Can you add those to the SOW stub before the kickoff and send a comment-ready copy to procurement@edgehealth.com?

Also — small internal note: we prefer the acceptance matrix to include an "operational readiness" row (runbooks + on-call) so our Ops lead can sign off.

See you Monday.

Devon Lim
Senior Engineering Manager, EdgeHealth
